summary: Ticks a UI screen state machine. Early-returns state code 2 when the exiting flag at +0x19D is already set. Otherwise obtains the current state code via an indirect vtable call through the dispatch struct at +0x190 (function pointer at +0x194) and returns it. On state 1 it either runs TextureSurfaceValidator (0x005159F5) and clears the pending flag at +0x1A0, or, when the flag at +0x19C is clear, issues a screen transition request by writing ID 34 to the screen object (+0x14) and invoking the screen vtable method at *a1, then calls VtableDelegateDispatch (0x00515DB8). On state 2 it sets the exiting flag at +0x19D to 1 and either clamps the target at +0x84 down to the selection at +0x7C, or, when the dispatch-struct byte at +0x1E1 is set, issues a transition request by writing ID 58 to the screen object (+0x14) and invoking the screen vtable method at *a1.

State 1 path, pending flag set: call TextureSurfaceValidator (0x005159F5) with (int)a1 to validate/refresh the screen's texture surfaces.
Clear the pending flag v1[20] at this+0x1A0 to 0 after texture validation completes.

Request the screen change: invoke the __cdecl vtable method at *a1 (obj+0x0) with a1, sending the transition ID written to obj+0x14.

State 2 path: record the exiting transition by setting v1[17] at this+0x19D to 1.
Guard 0: v4 = (v1[20] == 0) on the pending flag at this+0x1A0; when the flag was clear take the clamp branch, otherwise the special transition branch.
State 2, pending flag was clear: read the selection value v5 from a1[31] (this+0x7C) and clamp the target at a1[33] (this+0x84) down to v5 when the target is larger.
State 2, pending flag was set and the dispatch-struct byte at a1[100]+81 (this+0x1E1) is non-zero: write screen transition ID 58 to the screen object field at *a1 + 20 (obj+0x14).
Request the screen change: invoke the __cdecl vtable method at *a1 (obj+0x0) with a1, sending the transition ID 58 written to obj+0x14.
Return v3, the state code obtained from the state getter, to the caller.
